layout_dets.text: We introduce Lumiere – a text-to-video diffusion model designed for synthe-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sizing videos that portray realistic, diverse and coherent motion – a pivotal

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: challenge in video synthesis. To this end, we introduce a Space-Time U-Net

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: architecture that generates the entire temporal duration of the video at once,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: through a single pass in the model. This is in contrast to existing video models

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: which synthesize distant keyframes followed by temporal super-resolution –

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: an approach that inherently makes global temporal consistency difficult to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: achieve. By deploying both spatial and (importantly) temporal down- and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: up-sampling and leveraging a pre-trained text-to-image diffusion model, our

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: model learns to directly generate a full-frame-rate, low-resolution video by

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: processing it in multiple space-time scales. We demonstrate state-of-the-art

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: text-to-video generation results , and show that our design easily facili-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tates a wide range of content creation tasks and video editing applications,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: including image-to-video, video inpainting, and stylized generation.

layout_dets.text: 1 Introduction

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Generative models for images have seen tremendous progress in re-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cent years. State-of-the-art text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models are

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: now capable of synthesizing high-resolution photo-realistic images

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: that adhere to complex text prompts [Ramesh et al. 2022; Rombach

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: et al. 2022; Saharia et al. 2022b], and allow a wide range of image

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: editing capabilities [Po et al. 2023] and other downstream uses.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: However, training large-scale text-to-video (T2V) foundation mod-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: els remains an open challenge due to the added complexities that

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: motion introduces. Not only are we sensitive to errors in modeling

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: natural motion, but the added temporal data dimension introduces

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: significant challenges in terms of memory and compute require-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ments, as well as the scale of the required training data to learn

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: this more complex distribution. As a result, while T2V models are

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: rapidly improving, existing models are still restricted in terms of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: video duration, overall visual quality, and the degree of realistic

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: motion that they can generate. A prevalent approach among ex-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: isting T2V models is to adopt a cascaded design in which a base

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: model generates distant keyframes, and subsequent temporal super-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: resolution (TSR) models generate the missing data between the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: keyframes in non-overlapping segments. While memory efficient,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the ability to generate globally coherent motion using temporal cas-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cades is inherently restricted for the following reasons: (i) The base

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: model generates an aggressively sub-sampled set of keyframes, in

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: which fast motion becomes temporally aliased and thus ambiguous

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (ii) TSR modules are constrained to fixed, small temporal context

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: windows, and thus cannot consistently resolve aliasing ambiguities

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: across the full duration of the video (illustrated in Fig. 2 in the case

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of synthesizing periodic motion, e.g., walking). (iii) Cascaded train-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing regimens in general suffer from a domain gap, where the TSR

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: model is trained on real downsampled video frames, but at inference

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: time is used to interpolate generated frames, which accumulates

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: errors. Here, we take a different approach by introducing a new

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: T2V diffusion framework that generates the full temporal duration

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of the video at once. We achieve this by using a Space-Time U-Net

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (STUNet) architecture that learns to downsample the signal in both

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: space and time, and performs the majority of its computation in

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a compact space-time representation. This approach allows us to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: generate 80 frames at 16fps (or 5 seconds, which is longer than the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: average shot duration in most media [Cutting and Candan 2015])

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: with a single base model, leading to more globally coherent motion

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: compared to prior work. Surprisingly, this design choice has been

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: overlooked by previous T2V models, which follow the convention

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to include only spatial down- and up-sampling operations in the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: architecture, and maintain a fixed temporal resolution across the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: network [Blattmann et al. 2023b; Ge et al. 2023; Girdhar et al. 2023;

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Guo et al. 2023; Ho et al. 2022a,b; Po et al. 2023; Singer et al. 2022;

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Wang et al. 2023a; Zhang et al. 2023b]. To benefit from the power-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ful generative prior of T2I models, we follow the trend of building

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Lumiere on top of a pretrained (and fixed) T2I model [Hong et al

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2022; Saharia et al. 2022b; Singer et al. 2022]. In our case, the T2I

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: model works in pixel space and consists of a base model followed

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: by a spatial super-resolution (SSR) cascade. Since the SSR network

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: operates at high spatial resolution, applying it on the entire video

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: duration is infeasible in terms of memory requirements. Common

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: SSR solutions use a temporal windowing approach, which splits

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the video into non-overlapping segments and stitches together the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: results. However, this can lead to inconsistencies in appearance at

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the boundaries between windows [Girdhar et al. 2023]. We propose

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to extend Multidiffusion [Bar-Tal et al. 2023], an approach proposed

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: for achieving global continuity in panoramic image generation, to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the temporal domain, where we compute spatial super-resolution

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: on temporal windows, and aggregate results into a globally coherent

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: solution over the whole video clip. We demonstrate state-of-the-art

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: video generation results and show how to easily adapt Luimere to a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: plethora of video content creation tasks, including video inpainting

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (Fig. 6), image-to-video generation (Fig. 9), or generating stylized

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: videos that comply with a given style image (Fig. 8). Finally, we

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: demonstrate that generating the full video at once allows us to easily

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: invoke off-the-shelf editing methods to perform consistent editing

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: X-T slices. ImagenVideo struggles to generate globally coherent repetitive motion due to its cascaded design and temporal super resolution modules, which fail

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to resolve aliasing ambiguities consistently across temporal windows.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: DALL-E2 [Ramesh et al. 2022] and Imagen [Saharia et al. 2022b]

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: achieve photorealistic text-to-image generation using cascaded dif-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fusion models, whereas Stable Diffusion [Rombach et al. 2022] per-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: forms generation in a compressed low-dimensional latent space.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: A promising line of works design T2I diffusion models that gen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: erate high-resolution images end-to-end, without a spatial super-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: resolution cascaded system or fixed pre-trained latent space [Chen

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2023; Gu et al. 2023; Hoogeboom et al. 2023]. Here, we design a T2V

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: model that generates the full frame duration at once, avoiding the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: temporal cascade commonly involved in T2V models.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Text-to-Video Generation. Recently, there have been substantial ef-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: forts in training large-scale T2V models on large scale datasets with

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: autoregressive Transformers (e.g., [Hong et al. 2022; Kondratyuk

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: et al. 2023; Villegas et al. 2023; Wu et al. 2022]) or Diffusion Models

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (e.g., [Gupta et al. 2023; Ho et al. 2022a,b]). A prominent approach

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: for T2V and Image-to-Video generation is to “inflate” a pre-trained

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: T2I model by inserting temporal layers to its architecture, and fine-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tuning only those, or optionally the whole model, on video data

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: [Blattmann et al. 2023b; Ge et al. 2023; Girdhar et al. 2023; Pika

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: labs 2023; RunwayML 2023; Singer et al. 2022; Yuan et al. 2024].

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: PYoCo [Ge et al. 2023] carefully design video noise prior and obtain

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: better performance for fine-tuning a T2I model for video genera-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion. VideoLDM [Blattmann et al. 2023b] and AnimateDiff [Guo

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: et al. 2023] inflate StableDiffusion [Rombach et al. 2022] and train

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: only the newly-added temporal layers, showing they can be com-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: bined with the weights of personalized T2I models. Concurrent

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to our work, Diffusion Transformers [Peebles and Xie 2023] have

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: gained prominence in video generation following the release of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Sora [Brooks et al. 2024], enabling high-quality multi-resolution

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and multi-duration generation.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Interestingly, the ubiquitous convention of existing video genera-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion schemes is to maintain a fxed temporal resolution across the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: network, which limits their ability to process full-length clips. In this

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: work, we design a new inflation scheme which includes learning

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to downsample the video in both space and time, and performing

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the majority of computation in the compressed space-time feature

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: space of the network. We extend an Imagen T2I model [Saharia

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: et al. 2022b], however our architectural contributions could be used

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: for latent diffusion as well, and are orthogonal to possible improve-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ments to the diffusion noise scheduler [Ge et al. 2023], architecture

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: design [Brooks et al. 2024; Peebles and Xie 2023], or to the video

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: data curation [Blattmann et al. 2023a].

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: model on overlapping windows and utilize MultiDiffusion [Bar-Tal et al. 2023] to combine the predictions into a coherent result. See Sec.3 for details.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Our framework consists of a base model and a spatial super-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: resolution (SSR) model. As illustrated in Fig. 3b, our base model

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: generates full clips at a coarse spatial resolution. The output of our

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: base model is spatially upsampled using a temporally-aware SSR

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: model, resulting with a high-resolution video. We next describe the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: key design choices in our architecture, and demonstrate the appli-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cability of our framework for a variety of downstream applications.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 3.1 Space-Time U-Net (STUnet)

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: To make our problem computationally tractable, we propose to use

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a space-time U-Net which downsamples the input signal both spa-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tially and temporally, and performs the majority of its computation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: on this compact space-time representation. We draw inspiration

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: from Çiçek et al. [2016], who generalize the U-Net architecture

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: [Ronneberger et al. 2015] to include 3D pooling operations for ef-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ficient processing of volumetric biomedical data. Our architecture

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: is illustrated in Fig. 4. We interleave temporal blocks in the T2I

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: architecture, and insert temporal down- and up-sampling modules

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: following each pre-trained spatial resizing module (Fig. 4a). The tem-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: poral blocks include temporal convolutions (Fig. 4b) and temporal

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: attention (Fig. 4c). Specifically, in all levels except for the coarsest,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: we insert factorized space-time convolutions (Fig. 4b) which allow

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: increasing the non-linearities in the network compared to full-3D

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: convolutions while reducing the computational costs, and increas-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing the expressiveness compared to 1D convolutions [Tran et al.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2018]. As the computational requirements of temporal attention

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: scale quadratically with the number of frames, we incorporate tem-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: poral attention only at the coarsest resolution, which contains a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: space-time compressed representation of the video. Operating on

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the low dimensional feature map allows us to stack several temporal

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: attention blocks with limited computational overhead. Similarly to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: [Blattmann et al. 2023b; Guo et al. 2023], we train the newly added

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: parameters, and keep the weights of the pre-trained T2I fixed. No-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tably, the common inflation approach ensures that at initialization,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the T2V model is equivalent to the pre-trained T2I model, i.e., gener-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ates videos as a collection of independent image samples. However,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: in our case, it is impossible to satisfy this property due to the tem-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: poral down- and up-sampling modules. We empirically found that

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: initializing these modules to perform nearest-neighbor down- and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: up- sampling operations results with a good starting point (see SM)

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ary artifacts, we achieve smooth transitions between the temporal

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: segments by employing Multidiffusion [Bar-Tal et al. 2023] along the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: temporal axis. At each generation step, we split the noisy input video

layout_dets.text: 3.3 Implementation details

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: We train our T2V model on a dataset containing 30M videos along

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: with their text caption. The 2D-UNet follows the architecture of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Imagen (see details in [Saharia et al. 2022b]). We then inflate it by

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: inserting temporal layers as described in Sec. 3.1 and Fig. 4. The

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: videos are 80 frames long at 16 fps (5 seconds). The base model is

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: trained at 128× 128. We train the base model for 240K steps using 128

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: V5 TPUs with a batch size of 128. As discussed in Sec. 3, to benefit

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: from the T2I prior, we train only the temporal layers, hence we train

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: only on videos. We employ the ada factor optimizer [Shazeer and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Stern 2018] with its default configuration and a constant learning

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: rate of 1e-5. We apply the same Cosine noise scheduler used for the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pre-trained Imagen T2I model [Saharia et al. 2022b]. Note that unlike

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the Linear scheduler commonly used in latent space models, the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Cosine scheduler reaches a near zero SNR without any modifications

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: [Lin et al. 2024]. For the SSR model, we use the same architecture and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: optimization parameters as in Imagen SSR [Saharia et al. 2022b]. We

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: inflate the SSR model in a similar manner to our base model inflation.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Due to the extensive computational requirements, our inflated SSR

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: is adapted to handle 8 frames at once, and we apply MultiDiffusion

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: [Bar-Tal et al. 2023] to achieve consistency between windows (see

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Sec. 3.2). The SSR outputs 1024 × 1024 frames. Our STUnet and SSR

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: models contain 5.5B and 1B parameters respectively.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 4 Applications

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The lack of a TSR cascade makes it easier to extend Lumiere to down-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: stream applications. In particular, our model provides an intuitive

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: interface for downstream applications that require an off-the-shelf

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: T2V model (e.g., Gal et al. [2023]; Meng et al. [2022]; Poole et al.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: [2023]). We demonstrate this property by performing video-to-video

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: editing using SDEdit [Meng et al. 2022] (see Fig. 10). We next discuss

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a number of such applications, including style conditioned genera-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion, image-to-video, inpainting and outpainting, and cinemagraphs.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: We present example frames in Figs. 8-10 and refer the reader to the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Supplementary Material (SM) on our webpage for full video results

layout_dets.text: 4.1 Stylized Generation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Recall that we only train the newly-added temporal layers and keep

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the pre-trained T2I weights fixed. Previous work showed that substi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tuting the T2I weights with a model customized for a specific style

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: allows to generate videos with the desired style [Guo et al. 2023].

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: We observe that this simple “plug-and-play" approach often results

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: in distorted or static videos (see SM), and hypothesize that this is

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the temporal layers from the fine-tuned spatial layers. Inspired by

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the success of GAN-based interpolation approaches [Pinkney and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Adler 2020], we opt to strike a balance between style and motion by

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: linearly interpolating between the fine-tuned T2I weights,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and the original T2I weights,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: is chosen manually in our

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: experiments to generate videos that adhere to the style and depict

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.text: 4.2 Conditional Generation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Similarly to Blattmann et al. [2023b]; Wang et al. [2023b], we ex-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and the driving text prompt. Specifically, we add

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.text: . We ex-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: process, we take J to be the noisy version of the training video, and

layout_dets.text: 6 Conclusions and Limitations

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: We presented a new text-to-video generation framework, utilizing

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a pre-trained text-to-image diffusion model. We identified an inher-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ent limitation in learning globally-coherent motion in the prevalent

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: approach of first generating distant keyframes and subsequently

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: interpolating them using a cascade of temporal super-resolution

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: models. To tackle this challenge, we introduced a space-time UNet

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: architecture that directly generates full frame-rate video clips, by

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: incorporating both spatial, and temporal down- and up-sampling

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: modules. We demonstrated state-of-the-art generation results, and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: showed the applicability of our approach for a wide range of applica-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tions, including image-to-video, inpainting, and stylized generation.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: As for limitations, similar to other video generation works, our

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: model struggles at times to exactly follow the textual prompt, or to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: accurately generate fast and complex motion (e.g. gymnastics). Addi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tionally, our method is not designed to generate videos longer than

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 5 seconds, that consist of multiple shots, or that involve transitions

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: between scenes. Generating such content remains an open chal-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: lenge for future research. Furthermore, we established our model

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: on top of a T2I model that operates in the pixel space, and thus

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: involves a spatial super resolution module to produce high resolu-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion images. Nevertheless, our design principles are applicable to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: latent video diffusion models [Rombach et al. 2022], and can trigger

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: further research in the design of text-to-video models.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 7 Societal Impact

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Our primary goal in this work is to enable novice users to generate

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: visual content in a creative and flexible way. However, there is a risk

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of misuse for creating fake or harmful content with our technology,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and we believe that it is crucial to develop and apply tools for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: detecting biases and malicious use cases in order to ensure a safe

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and fair use.
